'''Dandamont Pring''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Consul-General|consul-general]] on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

The Empire assigned him on the planet to coordinate all [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] activities in [[Both system|the system]]. In practice however he didn't wish to be involved, waiting for his staff to tell him when a matter required his full attention; outside some briefings from his staff, he preferred to savor the joys coming with his prestigious office. He thew numerous, lavish parties and soirees in the [[Imperial Consulate (Bothawui)|Imperial Consulate]], with exotic [[foodstuff/Legends|foods]], expensive [[wine/Legends|wines]] and [[musician/Legends|musicians]]. The parties served in showing the benevolent face of the Empire, as Pring wanted to seem an ambassador of good-will.<ref name="guide" />

As a means of security, Pring ordered [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Janna Tammok]] to deliberately plant false information, hoping to reach any Bothan or [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[spy/Legends|spies]].<ref name="guide" />

He intended for his daughter, [[Praleena Pring|Praleena]], to marry [[Unidentified Imperial captain (Dismay)|the Captain]] of the ''[[Dismay]]''. He organized another opulent soiree to make the announcement of the engagement, scheduling for his daughter to depart the next day for the wedding. He didn't know that Praleena disliked the captain and had a secret affair with [[Unidentified Imperial defector|a minor bureaucrat]] of his estate, and that they both intended to defect to the Rebel Alliance. The extraction ruined the soiree right after the announcement, and the very presence of Praleena among the Rebels (disguised as trade delegates) aided their escape. He dismissed the incident as young love, claiming that his daughter would return once she thought things through.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=An Invitation to Defect|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>
